title: Present Simple – To Be – Negative
description: How to use am not, is not, and are not in negative Present Simple sentences

lessons.title: Negative Structure with To Be
lessons.content:
**Structure:** Subject + **am / is / are** + **not**

Use **am not** with **I**.
Use **is not** with **he / she / it** and singular nouns.
Use **are not** with **you / we / they** and plural nouns.

| Subject | Negative form | Example |
|---------|---------------|---------|
| I | am not | I am not happy. |
| You | are not | You are not happy. |
| We | are not | We are not happy. |
| They | are not | They are not happy. |
| He | is not | He is not happy. |
| She | is not | She is not happy. |
| It | is not | It is not happy. |

lessons.title: Short Negative Forms
lessons.content:
**Is not** can become **isn't**.
**Are not** can become **aren't**.
**Am not** usually stays **am not** after **I**.

| Long form | Short form | Example |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| is not | isn't | She isn't sleepy. |
| are not | aren't | They aren't at home. |
| am not | am not | I am not in the office. |

📌 Both long forms and short forms are correct: **He is not here** = **He isn't here**.

lessons.title: Common Mistakes
lessons.content:
⚠️ Do not leave out **am / is / are**.
⚠️ Do not add an extra pronoun after a noun subject.
⚠️ Put **not** after **am / is / are**.
⚠️ Do not use **do not / does not** with the verb **to be**.

| Incorrect | Correct |
|-----------|---------|
| I not a doctor. | I am not a doctor. |
| John he not Israeli. | John is not Israeli. |
| The children they not here. | The children are not here. |
| It not is sunny today. | It is not sunny today. |
